description: Generate 5-7-5 haikus from syllable-counted word banks — every line is guaranteed the right syllable count.

faqs.a: Lines are assembled from words with known syllable counts, so 5-7-5 is exact every time.
A bank of nature- and season-flavored words in 1, 2 and 3 syllable groups.

faqs.q: Will I get a different haiku each time?
faqs.a: Yes — lines are assembled randomly from the syllable-counted word banks, so every haiku is unique.
